decision.summary: No new action: the daily 79k reach thesis position remains valid and profitable, but it is still below the partial take-profit zone and no second same-day edge is clean enough.
decision.rationale: BTC is trading around 78.66k with bullish short-term Binance context, so the existing daily 79k reach position remains the correct live thesis expression. However, the market is still around 77.5-80.0% probability, which is below the playbook partial take-profit band of 80-85%, so there is no reason to reduce yet. Re-adding the same market is not justified because the live position already captures the thesis and any extra sizing would only make sense if the cash-per-position cap still clearly allowed it. No secondary daily or weekly market offers a cleaner edge: 80k reach is still too far for the remaining time window, while downside dailies and weeklys are too weak and out of sync with current price action.
